title.zh: 将达沃省马塔瑙市镇卡加奥拉斯村更名为斯韦尔特村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Kaga-Olas in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao, to Swerte
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Kaga-Olas in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao, to Swerte
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Kaga-Olas tại Thị trấn Matanao, Tỉnh Davao thành Swerte
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Kaga-Olas ในเทศบาล Matanao, จังหวัด Davao เป็น Swerte
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Kaga-Olas di Kotamadya Matanao, Provinsi Davao menjadi Swerte
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Kaga-Olas di Perbandaran Matanao, Wilayah Davao menjadi Swerte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2598_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Kaga-olas in the Municipality of Matanao, Province of Davao, is changed to Swerte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
